name: Shenzhen SDMC Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen SDMC Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a provider of smart home products including hardware and software products for customers in China and internationally. The company develops and sells digital video devices and network communication devices and provides system platforms and services. Its solutions allow users to control their home with the application of cloud, IoT and AI technologies, through its digital video devices, such as media streaming terminals, speakers, projectors, and cameras, network communication devices, such as optical network terminals, Wi-Fi routers, and cable modems, and system platforms, such as Cedar, XHome and XMediaTV.
